senses.sense_definition: An idea, plan, or possibility that someone mentions for others to consider.

examples.text: If you have a better <w>suggestion</w> for where to eat, please let me know.

target_lang_translations.fr: Si vous avez une meilleure <w>suggestion</w> pour l'endroit où manger, merci de me le faire savoir.

examples.text: I would like to make a <w>suggestion</w> regarding the new office layout.

target_lang_translations.pl: Chciałbym zgłosić <w>sugestię</w> dotyczącą nowego układu biura.
target_lang_translations.de: Ich möchte einen <w>Vorschlag</w> bezüglich der neuen Büroaufteilung machen.

senses.sense_definition: An indirect statement or insinuation that is not based on solid evidence.
